import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def work():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    dp = [[0] * (2 * n + 1) for _ in range(2)]
    dp[0][0] = 1
    ret = 0
    for p in range(1, 2 * n + 1):
        cur = p % 2
        prev = 1 - cur
        dp[cur] = [0] * (2 * n + 1)
        for i in range(2 * n):
            dp[cur][i + 1] = (dp[cur][i + 1] + dp[prev][i]) % MOD
            if i - 1 >= 0:
                dp[cur][i - 1] = (dp[cur][i - 1] + dp[prev][i]) % MOD
                if p % 2 == 0 and (2 * n - p) >= i - 1:
                    ret = (ret + dp[prev][i]) % MOD
    print(ret)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    work()
